title: THE EMPTY WINDOWS

floorplan.camera: on the pavement outside Bell's Umbrellas at dawn, looking along the shopfront toward the empty department-store windows across the street

anchors.BELL'S SHOP: the narrow Victorian shopfront of Bell's Umbrellas, its deep-red door ajar, its window empty
anchors.DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS: the long display windows across the street, lit but empty, their mannequins gone
anchors.PAVEMENT: the wet pavement between the shop and the kerb
anchors.PEDESTRIANISATION WORKS: the new bollards and barriers along the kerb

cast.depth: foreground, crouched at the shop's threshold
cast.action: crouches at the half-open shop door in profile, her face turned down to the punched ticket and away from the camera, her expression serious; her right hand holds the ticket up to the grey light, her left hand flat on the door frame; the folded route map open on her knee; her coat collar up

cast.depth: midground, at the empty window across the street
cast.action: stands at the empty department-store window in profile, his right palm flat on the glass, his left hand at his side; the black mask covers his whole face from hairline to chin; his masked face is turned to the empty display stands

cast.depth: foreground low, at the shop door
cast.action: sits at the shop door, both front paws on the pavement around a pale mannequin's hand, head cocked, ears up, tail still; she looks up at Lucy

props.anchor: BELL'S SHOP: held up in Lucy's right hand
props.description: a stiff card bus ticket, blank except for a single clean circular punch hole
props.state: the ticket is the only thing left at the shop door; it carries a single punched circle

props.description: a jointed wooden-and-plaster display mannequin's hand and wrist, pale and blank, with a brass cuff at the wrist; a mannequin part
props.state: the hand is a mannequin's hand lying on the pavement

props.anchor: DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS: on the empty display ledge inside the glass
props.description: a detached curved brass umbrella handle with a short ragged length of black silk umbrella fabric still attached, lying on the display ledge behind the glass; a tiny bell shape engraved on the brass
props.state: the handle is Ada's; it was left on the empty display ledge; it is a detached handle alone

props.anchor: BELL'S SHOP: open on Lucy's knee
props.description: a folded London bus route map, its route lines blank except for a single hand-drawn circle around a route that ends at a blank space
props.state: the map shows a route that has been retired; the circle is the only mark

moment: The first car-free dawn lands on an empty street: the department-store mannequins are gone, Bell's Umbrellas is cleared out, and Ada is missing. Cyndi finds a mannequin's hand; Lucy holds a punched ticket; Wyatt lifts a brass umbrella handle from the empty window.
environment: the first traffic-free morning on Oxford Street: wet pavement, new bollards, barriers stacked at the kerb, the long department-store windows dark and empty with bare display stands, Bell's Umbrellas' shutters half up, the shop dark inside, an overturned brass umbrella stand, blank repair tags, the door bell hanging still; a quiet pavement, every surface plain and unlettered, blank hoardings.
lighting: flat grey dawn, cold blue; one sodium lamp still burning at the corner; the shop's interior a dark rectangle; the empty windows reflecting the grey sky; the ticket and the brass handle the only bright things.
colour: near-monochrome grey and wet black; cream ticket, brass handle, the deep-red door of Bell's the only strong colour; the palette built from shop greys and timber browns.
negatives: tickets, route maps, timetables, shop signs and repair tags are plain blank panels of colour
the mannequin hand is a jointed display hand, its fibreglass wrist socket visible
the department-store windows hold bare glass and empty display platforms
clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck
Wyatt's mask is a smooth matte-black shield covering his whole face from hairline to chin, its surface plain black with two round eye holes
Wyatt's black mask covers his whole face edge to edge, hairline to chin
the only umbrella part in the frame is a detached curved brass handle with a scrap of black silk, lying on the display ledge
Lucy's face is turned down to the ticket, her expression intent
Cyndi is a tan Belgian Malinois-type shepherd with a black muzzle, erect ears, dark eyes, a lean athletic build and a short coat
the shop is a real independent umbrella shop with a narrow Victorian shopfront of bowed glass and worn dark timber
